name: Mesa Prime

prerequisites.detail: Any active Void Fissure node on the star chart matching the relic era (Lith/Meso/Neo/Axi). Vanguard relics run as Axi-tier.
All Mesa Prime relics are vaulted; you must already own them, buy them from Varzia during a Mesa rotation, or trade for them.
Maroo's Bazaar (Mars) or the Market console in the Orbiter. Needed only for the Aya route.
Trading is the fallback for relics and parts. Trade mastery-rank gate not re-verified on the wiki this pass.

vault.unvaultRoute: Prime Resurgence (Varzia) when a Mesa rotation is active
vault.rotationNote: Wiki rotation table ends at 2026-02-19..2026-03-19 (Banshee & Mirage). No wiki entry covers September 2026, so current Varzia stock cannot be confirmed from the wiki. Last listed Mesa rotations: Mesa & Limbo 2025-05-08..2025-06-05, Mesa & Hydroid 2024-08-01..2024-08-29.
vault.rotationCadence: Varzia stock rotates every 28 days at 18:00 UTC

relicListNote: Transcribed from the Acquisition table on wiki.warframe.com/w/Mesa/Prime. Five entries (Axi M1, Neo A3, Lith M3, Neo M2, Vanguard M1) were re-checked on their own relic pages and matched component and rarity. Lith C6's own page renders a malformed rarity split, so its Uncommon rating is taken from the Mesa/Prime table.

refinement.bestForSetCompletion: Radiant on the Neuroptics relics (Rare in every relic that holds it: 2% -> 10%) and on the rare-slot Systems relics (Lith M6, Neo M2, Neo M3). Run Chassis relics Intact - it is Common in all ten of its relics (25.33%). Blueprint: run Vanguard P1 Intact (Common) if you have it, otherwise Radiant the Uncommon relics (11% -> 20%).
refinement.bestForDucats: Intact. Zero traces, 76% chance of a Common part per crack, and a Common Prime part still sells for 15 ducats. Refining costs traces and lowers the Common odds, which is the opposite of what a ducat run wants.
refinement.bestForPlatinum: Radiant, and only on relics whose rare slot is a vaulted part (Mesa Neuroptics, Mesa Systems). Vaulted rare parts carry the trade value; commons from vaulted relics are near-worthless.
refinement.tracesPerCrack: 6-30 per mission when 10 Reactant are collected, plus 5 per squadmate who picks your reward

ducats.adjusted: Parts that were rare on an older relic but common/uncommon on a newer one pay 25/65 instead

community.painLevel: moderate; a currency grind, not a mission grind
community.recommendedMode: Solo, normal difficulty. Cetus tier 5 is already level 40-60, Steel Path adds nothing to Aya rates, and solo keeps camp levels and drone pathing under your control.
community.preferredRoute: The Aya mission route feeding the Varzia vendor route. Of the listed routes it is the only practical one while vaulted; trading for finished parts is the fallback. Void-mission Aya exists but is too uncommon to lead with.

ayaRoutes.why: Fewest stages that force you to stand and wait.
ayaRoutes.levelLockTrick: Take a bounty from Konzu, then deliberately fail stage 1. Every plains camp stays locked at the 40-60 tier, so you re-take bounties from the Grineer tents in the plains instead of flying back to Cetus.
ayaRoutes.frames: Volt or Nova, not optional for speed. Volt's Speed buffs the escort drone and the rescue target. Nova's portals teleport the drone: walk ahead of it and place the portal, keep the exit near ground level, and stay close or the drone will not path to it.
caveats: Some players report the tents not offering Search and Rescue at tier 5

ayaRoutes.standing: lower Aya per bounty, arguably better total return
ayaRoutes.why: Shorter tilesets, works with almost any frame, and Mother Tokens are uncapped where Cetus standing is not. Tokens buy relic packs, which loop back into relics and Aya, and Endo, Ayatan stars and Kuva accumulate alongside.
caveats: Loid still gets stuck on Isolation Vault stages; bring Nova

ayaRoutes.why: Personal-luck anecdotes only, no rate evidence.

timeEstimate.note: Community-reported; the wiki publishes no Aya rate.

traps: Flying back to Cetus between bounties instead of taking the next one from a plains tent.
Skipping the fail-stage-1 trick, which leaves the camps at low tiers and hands you slow low-level bounties.
Bringing a frame with no drone support: the escort drone sets the pace, not your damage.
Placing a Nova portal exit too high off the ground, or wandering away from the drone, so it refuses the portal.
Trusting pre-nerf Aya rates from older guides; the bounty-rerolling exploit was removed.
Cetus cave Exterminate stages and rock-snagged drones give back the time the tier 5 rate saves.
tips: Aya trades at 5-8 platinum each, commonly 6 Aya for 36p, so overfarming Aya is a platinum farm rather than waste.
Check the live Varzia rotation before committing to any Aya farm. If Mesa is currently unvaulted her relics drop from missions normally and the Aya route is unnecessary.

conflicts.wiki: Varzia is reachable at Maroo's Bazaar (Mars) or the Market console in the Orbiter.
conflicts.community: You farm Aya and buy the relics from Varzia in Maroo's Bazaar.
conflicts.why: The community write-up omits the Orbiter console, which saves a trip to Mars every rotation.

effortWhy: A full Prime set of relic drops behind a vault gate: relics are unfarmable, only bought 1 Aya at a time while a Mesa Varzia rotation is live, or traded for.
effortNote: Community evidence (~20 Aya/hour, 3-5 minute bounties) makes the currency side cheap but does not touch the 28-day rotation gate, which is what sets the rating. Unchanged at 7.
gotchas: No mission drops these relics. Farming fissures for Mesa relics is wasted time; get the relics from Varzia or trading first.
Varzia only carries Mesa relics while a Mesa rotation is live, and rotations change every 28 days at 18:00 UTC.
Mesa Prime Neuroptics is the Rare slot in every single relic that holds it, so it is the part that stalls the set - Radiant those relics, not the Chassis ones.
Argon Crystal decays after acquisition, so farm it last, right before you have the Neuroptics ready to build.
Nitain Extract has no farmable node worth running; buy 5 for 15 Nightwave Cred from the evergreen offerings.
The main Mesa Prime blueprint is itself a relic drop, not a Market purchase, so 'buy the blueprint' is not an option here.
Vanguard-tier relics (Vanguard P1/E1/M1/C1) were added in Hotfix 41.0.5 on 2025-12-18 and are already vaulted; they run as Axi-tier fissures.
Refining for ducats is backwards - Intact has the highest chance of a Common part, which is what you sell at 15 ducats.
